name: Short sums of distinct divisors of 5040
description: construct() -> at most 256 distinct positive divisors of n=5040 whose sum is target=4979. Minimize the number of selected divisors. Exact membership and sum checks; this is one finite practical-number instance. Represent 4979 as a sum of distinct divisors of 5040, minimizing the number of terms. This is one finite optimization instance, not Vose’s asymptotic theorem.
